name: Braised stuffed cabbage
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical Polish stuffed cabbage recipes using 6 large leaves (1-2 rolls per serving); source review issues note serving count needs enrichment
Total time sums active prep (~20 min for boiling, frying, stuffing) + 75 min baking; instructions give explicit oven times
Vegetarian confirmed by source and all ingredients; Vegan false due to listed honey
Pescatarian true as no meat/fish but allows honey
Gluten-free true: no barley/rye/wheat/oats; rice and chestnuts are gluten-free
Tree nuts true for chestnuts (botanically a nut, common allergen flag); all other allergens confidently absent based on ingredients
Cranberries assumed dried (standard for rice stuffing); rosemary assumed dried; no compound sauces or ambiguous items
instructions:
step 1
Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Remove the tough central stalk from the cabbage leaves. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the cabbage, then cook for just 1-2 mins until the leaves are starting to wilt. Drain and refresh under cold running water. Drain well, then pat dry with a tea towel.

step 2
Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion, then fry for 5 mins until slightly browned. Add the rosemary and celery, then cook for 8 mins more. Stir in the rice, then cook for a min or so until the grains are glistening. Remove from the heat, stir in the chestnuts and cranberries, then season.

step 3
Spoon a little stuffing onto a cabbage leaf, roll up and fold in the sides to enclose the filling. Put in a single layer in a large, oiled, shallow ovenproof dish with the join underneath. Fill the remaining leaves in the same way. Mix the stock, vinegar and honey, then pour over the cabbage. Cover the dish tightly with foil, bake for 1 hr, uncover, then cook for a further 15 mins.

ingredients.name: Cabbage Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: 6 large outer savoy cabbage leaves ~125g each raw weight; typical for Polish stuffed cabbage recipes

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp dried rosemary leaves ~3 g; typical dried herb density

ingredients.name: Celery
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium celery stalk chopped ~40 g raw

ingredients.name: Basmati Rice
ingredients.assumptions: dry basmati rice weight as listed; uncooked state before boiling in instructions

ingredients.name: Cooked Chestnut
ingredients.assumptions: vacuum-packed pre-cooked chestnuts as listed; typical drained weight

ingredients.name: Cranberry
ingredients.assumptions: dried cranberries (common in stuffing); 50 g as listed

ingredients.name: Vegetable Stock
ingredients.assumptions: standard vegetable stock from bouillon; 300 ml ≈ 300 g
